prs.title: fix(server): replay request SSE responses after closeSSEStream
prs.author: fallintoplace
prs.reason: [llm] cluster primary: SSE replay/reconnect is broken when a stream has been closed. PR #2214 only patches the regex in `buildWellKnownPath` and `buildDiscoveryUrls` but leaves the fallback guard checking a sentinel that can no longer be reached.
